description: ipld/builder.rs leaves ArticleMetadata.operator_signature as an empty Vec<u8> with a comment 'caller must populate'. There is no type-level enforcement that the signature is set before the article is written to IPFS or the group log. A caller that forgets to sign (or that encounters an error mid-pipeline and proceeds anyway) will silently write an unsigned article. Consider a builder pattern or a newtype like SignedBuiltArticle that is only constructible after signing.
title: core: operator_signature left empty in build_article; caller discipline required to sign before writing
